metadata.dataset: Timber sales + DNR stand exams along the full Minnesota North Country Trail — 2-mile corridor
metadata.corridor: Statewide NCT line (site/data/trail-minnesota.geojson, 348 features, 566.12 mi) buffered 2 mi (3,218.69 m); a feature counts when its polygon intersects the buffer

programs.county-sale: Sold/appraised county timber sales (Cass, Hubbard, Becker, Clearwater)
programs.usfs-edw-sale: USFS EDW timber-sale project areas (Chippewa + Superior NF)
programs.dnr-stand-exam-10yr: MN DNR 10-year stand exam list — stands planned for examination, NOT sold sales
programs.dnr-stand-exam-annual: MN DNR annual stand exam list — this year's cut of the same, NOT sold sales

regions.west: Wilkin, Otter Tail, Becker, Hubbard, Clearwater (ND border to Itasca State Park)
regions.arrowhead: St. Louis, Carlton, Lake, Cook (Superior NF / Border Route stretch)

metadata.note: County files in site/data/logging-*.geojson are untouched; their counts differ because they were clipped to the chapter bbox (lon -95.6 to -93.9), not the 2-mile buffer. DNR actual-sale polygons do not exist as a service; the DNR timber-sale calendar notices (PDFs with GPS points) are the actual-sales channel and are NOT in this file.
